don't double post --- it just makes it hard for us to keep
track of when questions are answered.

- Bob

> On Dec 13, 2015, at 7:48 PM, Ryan Batt <bat...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
>
> Hi all,
>
> I'm hoping that by posting here I this message will reach a wider audience than the issue I've posted on GitHub: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/243
>
> I get this error only when I try to use my full data set and specify more than 1 core. If I use only 1 core (e.g., 1 chain 1 core, full data set), I don't get the error, but CPU usage drops to 0, memory usage at ~5GB, and then nothing.
>
> Has anyone else ever come across this?
>
> My machine has plenty of resources. See the GitHub link for more of the details. Let me know if other information should be provided.
>
> I'm really stuck on this one.
>
> -Ryan
